title: DIGITIZATION EXECUTIVE INTERNSHIP
description:
Digitization Executive Internship
   

  

 The Digitization Executive is responsible for scanning, indexing, and uploading physical documents (A4, A3, legal, etc.) into the organization’s DMS (Document Management System). The role requires accuracy, confidentiality, and strong communication skills in both Malayalam and English to coordinate with various departments.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Receive, sort, and classify physical documents from client departments.
* Prepare documents for scanning by removing staples, pins, tapes, folds, etc.
* Ensure documents are complete and in proper sequence before digitization.
* Operate high\-speed scanners and multifunction devices efficiently.
* Digitize documents in required formats (PDF / searchable PDF).
* Handle mixed\-size documents (A4, A3, legal) without quality loss.
* Re\-scan unclear or incomplete pages to maintain accuracy.
* Upload scanned files into the correct folder structure as per the DMS guidelines.
* Apply correct metadata, tags, and naming conventions.
* Maintain version control whenever required.
* Ensure strict adherence to the predefined digital filing structure.
* Verify clarity, completeness, and legibility of scanned files.
* Cross\-check digital files with corresponding physical documents.
* Report missing, damaged, or incomplete documents to the supervisor.
* Maintain high standards of data confidentiality.


 What we Expect from you?
   

  

* Proficiency in Malayalam (reading, writing, speaking).
* Proficiency in English (reading, basic writing, speaking).
* Basic computer knowledge (Windows, PDF tools, file management).
* Familiarity with scanning devices and digitization workflow.
* Experience with any DMS is an advantage (training will be provided).
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Ability to follow structured processes and naming conventions.
* Minimum Degree qualification.
* 0–2 years of experience in document digitization, data entry, or office administration.
* Freshers with strong learning ability are welcome.


 What you've got?
   

  

* Hands\-on Experience with DMS
* Structured Training \& Support
* Skill Development
* Stable Work Environment
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Performance\-Based Recognition
* Language \& Communication Exposure
* Job Security \& Compliance Experience
* Certificate / Experience Letter

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \| PEOPLE CONSULTING \| LEARNING \& CHANGE**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

 Build consulting craft. Create with AI. Connect across languages.
   

  

**ROLE SNAPSHOT**
**Role**
 Staff Consultant, Learning \& Change
   

  

**Portfolio**
 Learning \& Development, People Consulting MENA
   

  

**Experience**
 2–4 years of relevant professional experience
   

  

**Capability model**
 Learning consulting with organisational change capability and AI\-enabled ways of working
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
 This role is an entry point into a consulting career in Learning and Change within EY GDS People Consulting. You will contribute to live MENA client work, strategic proposals and capability\-building initiatives across government, energy and financial services, with KSA as the primary growth market.
   

  

 You will own defined pieces of work, such as a storyboard, learning asset, stakeholder map, research pack, proposal section, workshop pack, readiness tracker or dashboard. The role blends learning design, change enablement, digital learning, project coordination and responsible use of AI. It is not a learning administration\-only position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Learning design and capability development**
* Support learning needs analysis, learner personas, skills\-gap reviews and role\-to\-capability mapping
* Help design learning journeys, curriculum maps, course outlines and blended learning experiences across ILT, VILT, WBT, microlearning and performance support.
* Develop e\-learning modules, storyboards, facilitator and learner guides, job aids, simulations, quick\-reference guides, assessments and reinforcement assets.
* Use adult learning principles and instructional design methods such as ADDIE or SAM, under guidance from senior team members.
* Support learning evaluation, feedback analysis, knowledge assessment and outcome reporting.


**Organisational change and adoption support**
* Maintain stakeholder registers, change\-impact logs, readiness trackers and adoption dashboards.
* Support stakeholder analysis, focus groups, surveys and workshop output synthesis.
* Draft change communications, campaign content, FAQs, toolkits and champion\-network materials for review.
* Assist with readiness, adoption and reinforcement activities that connect learning to business change outcomes.


**Pursuits, proposals and market support**
* Conduct structured client, sector, benchmark and competitor research for RFPs, RFQs and proactive proposals.
* Draft proposal content, credentials, CVs, case studies, methodology slides, workplan inputs and capability\-showcase materials.
* Create clear, consulting\-quality PowerPoint materials and maintain version control under tight deadlines.
* Review source material, support proposal content and participate in stakeholder discussions.
* Help maintain the capability, proposal and case\-study repositories.


**Client delivery, facilitation and learning operations**
* Own defined deliverables and project tasks, track dependencies and raise risks early.
* Prepare workshop materials, digital collaboration boards, logistics, attendance and feedback instruments; capture and structure outputs.
* Facilitate selected portions of learning sessions, focus groups and working meetings under appropriate supervision.
* Support learning intake, schedules, deployment, LMS or LXP content setup, testing, reporting and post\-course sustainment where included in project scope.
* Build collaborative working relationships with client contacts, subject\-matter experts and internal teams.


**AI\-enabled learning and digital content**
* Use Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools for research, synthesis, proposal support, storyboarding, assessment generation and content development.
* Apply human review, fact\-checking, privacy, copyright, accessibility and quality controls to all AI\-assisted outputs.
* Contribute to AI\-enabled learning use cases, including learning content generation, microlearning, personalised pathways and analytics support.
* Create or edit digital learning assets using tools such as Articulate Storyline and Rise, Captivate, Vyond, Camtasia, Synthesia, Clipchamp or comparable platforms.
* Support content upload, testing and reporting on platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed, Docebo, SharePoint or similar environments.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Consulting potential: Structures information clearly, asks good questions and connects deliverables to the client need.
* Written and visual communication: Produces concise English and well\-structured presentations with strong attention to detail.
* AI fluency: Uses AI productively and responsibly rather than treating generated output as final.
* Design sensibility: Understands learning experience, usability, visual hierarchy and audience needs.
* Ownership and coachability: Closes assigned work, raises risks early and applies feedback quickly.
* Organisation: Manages several tasks, deadlines and versions without losing quality.


**Qualifications And Experience**
**Essentia**
* 1–3 years of relevant experience in learning design, L\&D, content development, training delivery, change support, HR or organisational development, consulting or a related area.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, psychology, organisational development, communication, design or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design; exposure to ADDIE, SAM or comparable methods.
* Experience creating professional presentations, learning content, communications or structured business documents.
* Strong Microsoft PowerPoint, Word and Excel capability; familiarity with digital collaboration tools.
* Practical use of Microsoft Copilot or comparable generative AI tools for research, synthesis or content creation, with evidence of responsible review.
* Demonstrated business\-level proficiency to review proposal content, take part in stakeholder discussions and support workshops.
* Excellent spoken and written English and willingness to support MENA working hours.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a consulting, professional\-services, GCC\-facing or shared\-services environment.
* Exposure to organisational change frameworks.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one digital learning authoring or media tool.
* Exposure to LMS, LXP, digital adoption platforms, learning analytics or Power BI.
* Experience supporting proposals, market research, credentials or business\-development materials.
* Exposure to government, energy or financial\-services contexts.


**CERTIFICATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT**
 Required at joining or within the agreed development plan Preferred / differentiating
   

  

* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI fundamentals
* Design thinking / human\-centred design foundation
* Instructional design or adult learning foundation
* Change management foundation or agreed pathway
* PROSCI foundation or equivalent
* APTD or similar learning credential
* Agile fundamentals
* Articulate, learning platform or learning analytics credential


**WAYS OF WORKING**
 Initial ramp\-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
   

  

 Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.
   

  

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Dimension**
**Delivery**
 Support at least one significant learning or change workstream; deliver assigned outputs at first or second review with limited rework. Workplan, review records and engagement feedback.
   

  

**Pursuits**
 Support at least 5 strategic pursuits and contribute substantive content to at least 3 proposal submissions, subject to pipeline volume. Pursuit tracker and proposal records.
   

  

**AI adoption**
 Demonstrate responsible AI\-assisted working in research, proposals or content; contribute to one AI\-enabled learning use case or accelerator. Approved work samples, demo or use\-case record.
   

  

**Capability assets**
 Create or materially improve at least 2 reusable assets, templates, credentials or case studies. Repository and reuse log.
   

  

**Digital learning**
 Demonstrate working competence in at least one authoring or media tool and exposure to one learning platform or analytics tool. Skills assessment or project evidence.
   

  

**Growth**
 Complete agreed learning, change and AI development milestones and show progress toward Consultant readiness. Development plan and certification record.
   

  

**Utilisation**
 Meet the approved grade utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with targets calibrated to actual staffing. Utilisation and resource reports.
   

  

**What Ey Offers**
* Exposure to live MENA learning, change, digital adoption and workforce capability programmes.
* A structured pathway across learning consulting, organisational change, AI\-enabled learning and consulting craft.
* Hands\-on experience with modern authoring tools, learning platforms, analytics and approved AI tools.
* Coaching from experienced consultants and the opportunity to shape a growing portfolio.
* A career path from Staff Consultant to broader workstream and solution ownership.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Workstream ownership; proposal solutioning; client\-facing delivery

* CCMP.

* Learning analytics, LMS, LXP or talent\-platform certification.

title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.
